runtimeArgs: cd frontend || exit 1; if [[ -n ${AVER_SUPABASE_URL:-} && -z ${AVER_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY:-} || -z ${AVER_SUPABASE_URL:-} && -n ${AVER_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY:-} ]]; then echo "Set both AVER_SUPABASE_URL and AVER_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, or neither." >&2; exit 1; fi; export VERCEL_ENV=development AVER_ENVIRONMENT=test AVER_API_BASE=http://localhost:8000 && unset AVER_RUNTIME_CONFIG_OUT && node tooling/generate-runtime-config.mjs && npm run dev -- --port 3000
